reason: My whiteboard, Excel and Xero have run this business for years without a monthly bill, and I don't have the spare hours between booking calls and driving runs to learn a new system and chase my drivers onto an app. The free move-in and 60-day trial are decent, but I'd still have to change how I work, and nothing is broken badly enough to make me do that.
objection: It's a brand-new company with not one operator using it yet. I'd be the guinea pig, and if it can't really cope with how I quote charters, or it folds in a year, I've wasted my time and I'm back to the whiteboard anyway.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it running at another coach operator my size, ideally one I know or can ring, quoting real charters and getting through an accreditation audit without trouble.
